Comic and commentator Jimmy Dore joins Tucker Carlson to attack Bill Gates, weaponized wokeness, and the modern Democratic Party. Dore comes from the left, which makes his fury at his own side the point of the talk. He is funny and furious in equal measure throughout.

Dore traces how Gates spends his fortune to shape health and food policy worldwide. He argues that woke language became a tool to silence working-class critics. Carlson asks why so many former Democrat voters now back Trump. The disillusioned get a left-wing case against the establishment, told by a man who left it.

Section 285e of Title 2 of the United States Code sets compensation for the Law Revision Counsel and staff. Title 2 covers Congress, and this section sits in the chapter on that office, which keeps the Code in order. The hosted text is the version current in twenty twenty six. Pay is set by the Speaker within a cap.

The Counsel is paid at a yearly gross rate set by the Speaker, the text states. That rate may not exceed the greater of a dollar amount stated in the section or a rate set under a Speaker order. Staff of the office other than the Counsel are then dealt with in the text that follows. Neutral code editors are paid under the House's chief officer.
